selection_note: These 11 illustrations were curated after unblinding from the frozen challenger-stratified confirmation review: 46 text and 15 photo cases, including agreements and all five revised-guide photo disagreements. The sample is not representative of population accuracy or balanced between designs. Reviewers saw anonymous A/B assignments and each pair’s own full catalog; notes were sealed before identities were revealed. Their exact model identity is unknown, their compute is outside the experiment API ledger, and their judgments are fallible. One text case has apparently transposed rationales; its sealed bytes and counts remain preserved, but it is excluded from these illustrations. No replacement review or further tuning followed confirmation.
reviewer: unknown (not exposed by harness) (coding harness; outside API ledger)

examples.summary: The revised guide explicitly includes social conversation, yet Decisions rejects this greeting as Other. The blinded reviewer supports Sol and calls the rejection unsupported. The original guide is less explicit, and its choices were judged plausible.

assignments.description: Assistant identity, abilities, feelings, background, and social conversation; changing names, forms of address, language, voice, or response behavior; connecting, disconnecting, locating, resetting, and controlling devices or appliances, and checking their status.

The catalog describes conversation about assistant attributes but does not explicitly include general greetings.

examples.text: what do i do now that my battery is dead
examples.summary: Both guides leave a reasonable ambiguity: the battery could belong to a car or another device. The reviewer considers Sol’s vehicle-care interpretation and Decisions’ Other plausible, rather than treating either as an obvious error.

assignments.evidence: The dead battery could belong to a car or an unspecified device, so the subject is unresolved.

assignments.description: Personal vehicle selection, maintenance, repairs, and care, including safety ratings, service history and dates, maintenance schedules, oil changes, tires, fuel, mileage, and car washing.
assignments.evidence: A dead battery is a common vehicle-maintenance problem, although no vehicle is named.

assignments.description: Choosing, maintaining, repairing, and caring for a personal vehicle. Includes safety ratings, service history, oil changes, tires, fuel, mileage, and car washing.
assignments.evidence: The wording is consistent with a car battery needing attention, but does not identify a car.
The missing battery owner leaves uncertainty between vehicle care and device issues.

pair_reviews.boundary_note: Battery trouble crosses vehicle care and device troubleshooting when the object is unstated.
A battery-related request needs an object to distinguish vehicle care from device support.

examples.text: what are the steps to rollover my 401k
examples.summary: A 401k rollover crosses financial transfers and employee benefits. The reviewer supports both revised-guide choices despite their disagreement. The original pair agrees on employee benefits; agreement alone cannot resolve the overlapping scope.

assignments.description: Employee paychecks, payment timing, payroll direct deposit, annual earnings, tax forms, employee benefits, and vacation or time-off balances, usage, requests, and request status.
assignments.evidence: A 401k rollover is an administrative matter involving an employment retirement benefit.

assignments.description: Bank accounts and access; credit/debit cards, bills, payments, transfers, interest, rewards, credit scores, transaction histories, problems and fees, budgeting, financial values including stocks and property, currency exchange, and insurance policies.
assignments.evidence: A rollover concerns moving retirement funds between financial accounts.

assignments.description: Paychecks, direct deposit, annual earnings, tax forms, employee benefits, and vacation or time-off balances and requests.
assignments.evidence: Instructions for rolling over an employment retirement plan fit employee benefits.

assignments.description: Paychecks, direct deposit, annual earnings, tax forms, employee benefits, and vacation or time-off balances and requests.
assignments.evidence: Instructions for rolling over an employment retirement plan fit employee benefits.

pair_reviews.boundary_note: A retirement-plan rollover overlaps employee-benefit administration and financial-account transfers.
Retirement benefits can also be treated as financial accounts when funds are transferred.
